topic: nlohmann/json Basic Usage and Type Conversion
extracted_claim: nlohmann/json v3.12.0 is a single-header JSON library. Supports implicit conversion between json and C++ types (string, int, float, bool, vector, map). json::parse() from string, json::dump() to string. Supports nested objects and arrays. Supports custom type serialization via from_json/to_json ADL functions. JSON_DIAGNOSTICS enables parent pointers for better error messages.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no serialization. nlohmann/json is the standard C++ JSON library for config files and data exchange.

extracted_claim: nlohmann/json uses inline namespace versioning (e.g. json_abi_diag_v3_12_0). JSON_DIAGNOSTICS, JSON_DIAGNOSTIC_POSITIONS, JSON_USE_LEGACY_DISCARDED_VALUE_COMPARISON control ABI tags. Version check: NLOHMANN_JSON_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH. JSON_NO_IO disables stream operators. Hedley library provides cross-compiler attribute macros.
implementation_relevance: ABI versioning prevents ODR violations when multiple TUs include different versions.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE does not use inline namespaces
